text: Water expands when it freezes, so ice is less dense than liquid water and floats.
A light-year is the distance light travels in one Julian year (about 9.46 trillion km).
The adult human body is estimated at about 3.7 x 10^13 cells (Sender, Fuchs & Milo, 2016).
Sound is a mechanical pressure wave and cannot propagate through a vacuum.
Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy stored in carbohydrates.
Earth's inner core is about 5,200 C, comparable to the Sun's surface (~5,500 C).
Antibiotic resistance evolves when bacterial populations are under selective pressure.
A black hole's event horizon is the boundary beyond which escape velocity exceeds light speed.
Honey's low water activity and high sugar content inhibit microbial growth; edible honey has been found in ancient Egyptian tombs.
Octopuses have three hearts: two branchial hearts pump blood through the gills, one systemic heart serves the body.
Venus rotates once every ~243 Earth days, longer than its ~225 Earth-day orbit.
Botanically, bananas are berries; strawberries are aggregate accessory fruits, not berries.
Sharks first appear in the fossil record ~450 million years ago; the earliest trees ~385 million years ago.
A teaspoon of neutron-star matter would have a mass of order 10^12 kg (about a billion tons).
